title: Design: Deposit-held Bill To shows the deposit tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A, with a $10.00 deposit taken on it and not reversed, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-06-after-read-only.png, bt-p3-07-after-hover.png, bt-p3-05-before-card.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Hover over the Bill To value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill To shows customer A's name; it looks the same as an editable Bill To at rest. The Change Customer icon is still shown.

Step 2:

  • A dark grey tooltip reads "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer A's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits), story SV-12308 (Story 6, Change Customer with a Bill To)

  • S5-R4: “While deposits are held on an Open document, the field is read-only with M1 as its tooltip.”
  • S5-R7: “M1 names the total not reversed and the customer it was taken from, or "[N] customers" when there are several.”
  • S6-R3: “The existing deposit block on Change Customer applies only when the change would change the Bill To.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Read-only" (This build), "Hover" (This build), "Card" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-06-after-read-only.png
  • bt-p3-07-after-hover.png
  • bt-p3-05-before-card.png

The design's own words:

  • “Tooltip: "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from 7 Star Truck Repair. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."”

Difference: the tooltip is drawn as one long line at the window's bottom left (BT-D08).
